description: This file contains a mock implementation of the IStringIterator interface for testing purposes, utilizing Google Mock framework. It defines a template class MockStringIterator with mock methods corresponding to the interface's methods.

classes.name: MockStringIterator
classes.description: A template mock class implementing WPEFramework::RPC::IStringIterator for testing, with mock methods for iterator operations.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Mimics moving the iterator to the next element, returning true if successful.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element, returning true if successful.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the beginning.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the iterator is at a valid position.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Queries for a specific interface implementation.
